10:52
Yes, you can request to cancel after placing an order, but there is not a fixed time window. Orders move through our system very quickly, so the best chance of success is to request a cancellation straight away via our Contact us page. We will do our best, but cancellation is not guaranteed once processing has started, and we also cannot make changes to items on an existing order.
If the order has already been processed or dispatched, please return it once it arrives.
